AB06·0043M-(M) ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT THIS ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT AND EASEMENT AGREEMENT (this "Agreement"), made as of the 24" day of January, between Eastside 77 Associates LLC, a Delaware limited liability company, maintaining offices at c/o Alchemy Properties, Inc., 200 Madison Avenue, New York, NY 10016 Attn.: Ken Horn ("Developer"), and G & G Realty Co., a New York general partnership, having an address at 70-04 60" Avenue, Maspeth New York 11378 ("Owner") (Owner and Developer are. sometimes-hereafter collectively referred to as the "Parties"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Owner is the owner in fee of certain land, with the building and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of Manhattan, City, County and State of New York, known as Lot3inBlock1452on theTaxMapof theCityof NewYork,and as andbythestreet address 1484 Second Avenue, New York,New York, and more particularly described on Exhibit “A" annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the “Owner Land"), the building located thereon or which may be located thereon in the future is herein referred to as the “Owner Building"; and the Owner Land and the Owner Building are herein collectively referred to as the “Owner Parcel"); WHEREAS, Developer is the owner in fee of certain land located in the Borough of Manhattan, City, County, and State of New York, known as Lots 1 and 2 in Block 1452 on the Tax Map of the City of New York,and as and by the street address 1480 and 1482 Second Avenue, New York, New York, and more particularly described on Exhibit “B" annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land being herein called me “Developer Land"); and the Developer Land and the Developer Building are herein collectively referred to as the "Developer Parcel"); WHEREAS, the Owner Building contains less floor area, as defined in the Zoning Resolution (as hereinafter defined),than is now available for use on the Owner Parcel pursuant to the Zoning Resolution, so that the Transferable Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) are available for transfer to and utilization on the DeveloperParcel; WHEREAS,it is contemplated that the Developer Building will contain more floor area (as hereinafter defined) than is now available for use on the Developer Parcel pursuant to the Zoning Resolution (as hereinafter defined), and the parties hereto therefore desire to utilize the procedure available pursuant to the Zoning Resolution for the Merged Zoning Lot (as hereinafter defined) so as to make available the Transferable Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) and/or the Additional Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) for utilization in connection with the 1 1480.1482&14842Ave NYC ZLDA

construction and maintenance of the Developer Building, and Owner is willing to make such Transferable Development Rights available to Developer in perpetuity; WHEREAS, it is contemplated that theDeveloperBuildingwill require the use of a light and air easement and a cantilever easement over and above Owner Parcel, and Developer will herein acquire a Light and Air Easement and Cantilever Easement from Owner as herein provided. As used in this Agreement, the“Light and Air Easement”shall mean the right of Developer, in view, except for the air space occupied or that may be occupied by the Owner Development Envelope. As used in this Agreement, the “Cantilever Easement” shall mean the exclusive, permanent and perpetual easement of Developer to use the air space over the Owner Parcel starting ninety eight and one-half 98.5 feet above the Datum (as used in this agreement, the term "Datum” shall mean the datum used by the Topographical Bureau, borough of Manhattan, which is 2.752 feet above the National GeodeticSurveyVertical Datum of 1929 (UnitedStates Coast and Geodetic Survey) mean sea level, Sandy Hook, New Jersey (the “Easement Starting Plane"), and to extend no more than eight (8) feet beyond the border (i.e., the lot line) where the Owner Parcel and the Developer Parcel meet, in order to cantilever the Developer Building over the Owner Parcel, and to construct, use, maintain, repair, reconstruct and rebuild that portion of the Developer Building located therein. The Cantilever Easement does not extend into the Owner DevelopmentEnvelope. source (hereinafter “Additional Development Rights"or “ADR") so as to further increase the potential floor area of the Developer Building. WHEREAS,the parties hereto are simultaneously herewith executing (i) a Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions (the “Declaration") in accordance with certain provisions set forth in a definition of the term“zoning lot”in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution in order to create a single zoning lot of the Owner Parcel and the Developer Parcel (such zoning lot, as the same maybe enlarged or modified inaccordance with the Declaration and the termsof this Agreement, is herein referred to as the “Merged Zoning Lot"), and (i) such other agreements, easements and licenses as are reasonably necessary to effectuate the intent of the parties in connection with the Transferable Development Rights (the Declaration and such other agreements, easements and licenses are herein collectively referred to as the “Zoning Documents"); and WHEREAS, the parties hereto wish to set forth certain agreements with respect to their rights and obligations in and to the Merged Zoning Lot and other matters. NOW THEREFORE,in consideration of the mutual covenants and agreements contained herein, and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby conclusively acknowledged, the parties hereto hereby covenant and agree as follows: 1.
